purpose: Capital-preservation successor screen after the Alpha 015 two-position veto. This screen asks whether a distinct, at-most-two-position Binance USDT-M futures hypothesis can be admitted without reopening a sealed failed family or adding an unmodelled hedge.

hard_filters: at most two simultaneous Binance USDT-M perpetual futures positions at planned leverage no greater than one
fixed, causal decision inputs with a documented availability path
price PnL, fees, slippage, funding, interim mark-to-market and liquidation treatment
independent of a sealed failed or currently accumulating family
no spot, cross-venue, borrowing or synthetic hedge outside the USDT-M-only scope

candidates.name: ALPHA015_MINUTE_CROSS_CRYPTO_PREDICTABILITY
candidates.quality: Internal pre-return contract check. The template requires a 30-instrument universe and equal-weight top/bottom quintiles, or at least 12 concurrent futures positions.
candidates.reason: This violates the active two-position capital-preservation limit. No return data was acquired; the candidate is not retuned into a different strategy.

candidates.name: BINANCE_USDTM_COINTEGRATION_OR_COPULA_PAIR
candidates.quality: 2026 peer-reviewed open-access study using ten Binance USDT perpetuals, explicit funding, fees and spread assumptions, and a market-neutral two-leg implementation.
candidates.reason: The market-neutral variants were negative after costs even with maximum drawdowns below 20%. A two-leg version also overlaps the sealed Alpha 002 mean-reversion family; changing its pair selection or thresholds would be prohibited retuning.

candidates.name: SPOT_PERPETUAL_RANDOM_MATURITY_ARBITRAGE
candidates.quality: Academic perpetual-futures theory and empirical study that explicitly describes the capital, funding, bid-ask and liquidation risks of its random-maturity arbitrage implementation.
candidates.reason: The mechanism requires a spot position hedged against the perpetual. It is therefore not a Binance USDT-M-futures-only two-position sleeve and overlaps the already closed same-asset spot/perpetual carry family.

selected_next_step: NO_NEW_ALPHA_REGISTERED. Alpha 015 is closed before return-data acquisition. Preserve failed-family boundaries and continue only sealed forward/execution evidence for Alpha 001, Alpha 007 and Alpha 011. Any successor must begin as a separately screened two-position hypothesis with no return-data access before preregistration.
